function stagePaper(image){const source=new URL(image.currentSrc||image.src,location.href).pathname,asset=Object.values(options.assets.stage_papers||{}).find(a=>source.endsWith('/'+a.source));if(!asset)return null;const s=getComputedStyle(image),b=rect(image.getBoundingClientRect());if(!visible(image)||!image.naturalWidth||!b.width||!b.height)return null;if(image.naturalWidth!==asset.image_width||image.naturalHeight!==asset.image_height){violations.push('STAGE_ASSET_DIMENSIONS_CHANGED '+asset.source);return null;}const m=s.transform.match(/^matrix\(([^)]+)\)$/)?.[1].split(',').map(Number);if(m&&(Math.abs(m[1])>.0001||Math.abs(m[2])>.0001||m[0]<=0||m[3]<=0)){violations.push('UNSUPPORTED_STAGE_PAPER_TRANSFORM '+source);return null;}if(s.objectFit!=='contain'||s.objectPosition!=='50% 50%'){violations.push('UNSUPPORTED_STAGE_PAPER_FIT '+source+' '+s.objectFit+' '+s.objectPosition);return null;}const scale=Math.min(b.width/asset.image_width,b.height/asset.image_height),draw={x:b.x+(b.width-asset.image_width*scale)/2,y:b.y+(b.height-asset.image_height*scale)/2,width:asset.image_width*scale,height:asset.image_height*scale},p=asset.paper_rect;return {rect:{x:draw.x+p.x*scale,y:draw.y+p.y*scale,width:p.width*scale,height:p.height*scale},draw,owner:owner(image),asset:asset.source,sha256:asset.sha256,mode:'fixed prop source-paper pixels → actual object-fit contain image, including letterbox offset',own_text_selectors:asset.own_text_selectors};}
if(evidence.hidden_scroll_text.length)violations.push('SCROLL_CONTENT_PENDING '+evidence.hidden_scroll_text.length+' text nodes require additional actual scroll captures');
return {nodes,blockers,violations:[...new Set(violations)],evidence,coordinate_space:'document CSS pixels; window scroll offset included; internal scroll remains current actual position'};

customAdapters.guard: function assertBatchEnvironment(cache){if(document.querySelectorAll('#lab img,#lab button,#lab input,#lab .stage').length)throw Error('INK_ONLY_STRUCTURE_CHANGED');const el=document.querySelector('#game-hint');if(!el||el.childNodes.length!==1||el.firstChild.nodeType!==Node.TEXT_NODE)throw Error('INK_ONLY_TEXT_STRUCTURE');for(const ch of el.textContent)if(!cache.alphabet.includes(ch))throw Error('ALPHABET_CHANGED '+ch);const s=getComputedStyle(el);for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(cache.hintComputed))if(s[key]!==value)throw Error('BATCH_HINT_CSS_CHANGED '+key);const body=getComputedStyle(document.body);for(const[key,value]of Object.entries(cache.bodyComputed))if(body[key]!==value)throw Error('BATCH_BODY_CHANGED '+key);}
customAdapters.borderCache: for(const [name,value] of borderUrls){const receipt=options.cache.borders[name];if(!receipt?.verified || value!==options.cache.borderSources[name])throw Error('BATCH_SKIN_CHANGED '+name);borderReceipts.set(name,{...receipt,method:'cached fixed source receipt from full frozen batch boundary'});}

scope: ink/clip/safe only; network receipts cached per verified batch; no full blocker/paint gate
